qt: to the Council Fabio De Masi (NI) Subject:

According to press reports, secret peace plans for the conflict in Ukraine were drawn up before the 28-point plan1. The reports state that the German Government was already aware of an ‘Istanbul Plan’ on 4 November 2025. German and European diplomacy’s response to this has been cautious. 1.
Was the plan discussed at Council level?
Were Member States aware of the plan?
at: (English version) to the Council Fabio De Masi (NI) (6 January 2026) Subject: Secret peace plans for the conflict in Ukraine According to press reports, secret peace plans for the conflict in Ukraine were drawn up before the 28-point plan (1). The reports state that the German Government was already aware of an ‘Istanbul Plan’ on 4 November 2025. German and European diplomacy’s response to this has been cautious. 1.
Was the plan discussed at Council level?
Were Member States aware of the plan?

Reply (30 March 2026) It is not for the Council to comment on articles appearing in the press. As to Member States’ awareness of any plan, we would invite the Honourable Member to address his queries to the Member States in question.
